name: Brand Carousel
author: ferdausalom

sections.description:
Brand Carousel lets you display your client logos, company partners, sponsors, or product images in a beautiful and responsive carousel. This lightweight plugin works with any theme and is extremely easy to use. Simply add your brand images, adjust the settings, and insert the shortcode to display the carousel anywhere on your site.

This plugin is ideal for:
– client logo showcases
– partner brand sliders
– sponsor carousels
– product logo displays
– responsive image sliders

You can add unlimited slides, reorder images, and display the carousel using a simple shortcode.

No coding knowledge required — it just works.

Features

  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • Unlimited brand/logo slides
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Simple shortcode usage
  • Clean and minimal design
  • No tracking or external requests

Shortcode

Use this shortcode to display the brand carousel:

[brand-carousel]

Privacy Notice

This plugin does not:
* track users;
* send data to any external server;
* use cookies.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact the developer directly at:

Email: faferdaus@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire brand-carousel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Brands Carousel to add your brand images.
sections.faq:
How do I add slides?

Go to Brands Carousel in your WordPress admin and upload your brand or logo images.

Can I add multiple carousels?

Currently, the plugin supports one global carousel. Multi-carousel support will be added in future updates.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, it works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, Beaver Builder, and all major page builders.

Does the plugin track any data?

No. This plugin does not collect personal data or send information to external servers.
